learningObjectives: Update or remap a model without discarding its references.
Distinguish suggested ValueRange choices from application validation.

studyGuide.sectionTitle: Rescan without losing the model link

elements.text: Rescan updates an existing model while preserving its TestCase references. Open the appropriate SUT screen; right-click the Module → Rescan or Ctrl+Shift+R. WebDriver-created XBrowser Modules have a separate Rescan WebDriver command.

Add new controls deliberately. Unmapped controls can be mapped to controls of the same business type; inspect old/new property choices and save the update. Independent guidance: rerun affected tests rather than treating reference preservation as proof of passing behavior.

Small identifier adjustments can be made in Properties. Do not delete a used Module simply to rescan it: that loses its links. Replacing an unusable model requires a deliberate migration before removing the original.

ModuleAttribute ValueRange supplies dropdown choices in TestStepValues; user-specific values can also be entered. It is not an assertion that the SUT accepts only those values or a universal runtime validation lock.

Separate entries with semicolons. Exact strings include spaces: EUR;USD;GBP names three entries without leading spaces. Spaces inside a legitimate value remain significant. XScan may populate choices from ComboBox/ListBox controls.
Independent guidance: define allowed application behavior separately and test both valid and invalid inputs where appropriate. A dropdown suggestion does not replace those expectations.

Merge Modules requires the same technology. Select the intended target first, then the source; inspect the assistant and use Switch Modules if needed. Resolve conflicting properties deliberately, rather than deleting a steering parameter just because it raises a warning.

A completed full merge retains the target, removes the source and maintains references. If required objects cannot be checked out in a multi-user workspace, Partial Merge can leave the source in place. Check the outcome before treating consolidation as complete.
Independent guidance: matching names or a shared page do not prove model equivalence. Check controls, identifiers and affected TestSteps before and after consolidation.

elements.caption: Independent comparison: rescan updates a model; full/partial merge outcomes differ.

elements.text: On a disposable compatible model, inspect rescan mapping, configure exact ValueRange suggestions and compare a full merge with a checkout-blocked partial merge. Original Academy Exercise 18 and its figures were inaccessible; this is independent practice, not an executed course exercise.

examPitfalls.title: Reference preservation
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Assuming retained links prove a test passes.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Inspect changed mappings and rerun affected behavior.

examPitfalls.title: Suggestions vs validation
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Treating ValueRange as a runtime rejection rule.

examPitfalls.title: Exact strings
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Preserve legitimate spaces and avoid accidental leading ones.

examPitfalls.title: Merge scope
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Merging unrelated technologies or deleting conflict properties blindly.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Inspect compatibility and intended property values.

examPitfalls.title: Full vs partial
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Assuming the source is always deleted.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Partial Merge can retain it when checkout is blocked.

practiceQuiz.scenario: After a SUT deployment, a button's HTML class attribute changed from 'btn-primary' to 'btn-action'. The existing Module still references the old class. What is the correct action?

options.text: Rescan the existing Module to update the Control's properties with the new attribute.
Delete the old Module and scan the button again to create a new one.
Manually edit every TestStep that uses this Module to reflect the new attribute.
No action needed — Tosca automatically detects SUT changes.

practiceQuiz.rationale: Rescan updates the existing model; inspect its mapping and rerun affected tests.

optionExplanations.B: Discards the used model link unnecessarily.
optionExplanations.C: Repeats technical maintenance at every use.
optionExplanations.D: Changed identification should be inspected, not assumed repaired.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Two compatible XModules describe the same Login page. Which operation supports consolidating them after inspecting mappings and conflicts?

options.text: Keep both Modules and use whichever is more complete.
Use Module Merge to combine the two Modules into one authoritative module.
Delete one Module and manually update all TestCases that referenced it.
Use Rescan on both modules to synchronize their properties.

practiceQuiz.hint: Two Modules for the same element = merge them.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Module Merge supports consolidation; compatibility and resolved conflicts matter.

optionExplanations.D: Rescanning both does not consolidate them.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which feature supplies EUR, USD and GBP as dropdown suggestions for a ModuleAttribute's TestStepValues, while still allowing user-specific input?

options.text: Use ActionMode Constraint to restrict the value.
Add a Verify step in every TestCase that uses this Control.
Create a separate Module for each currency option.
Set ValueRange on the ModuleAttribute.

practiceQuiz.hint: Suggested choices are not a SUT validation assertion.
practiceQuiz.rationale: ValueRange supplies choices; it does not replace application validation.

optionExplanations.A: Constraint narrows node identification, not these suggestions.
optionExplanations.B: A Verify step checks behavior rather than supplies dropdown choices.
optionExplanations.C: Separate models are not needed just to suggest data.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which semicolon-separated entry lists exactly Code1, Code2, Code3 and Code4 without leading spaces?

options.text: Code1, Code2, Code3, Code4
Code1; Code2; Code3; Code4
Code1;Code2;Code3;Code4
Code1 Code2 Code3 Code4

practiceQuiz.rationale: Semicolons separate entries and spaces are preserved as part of their strings.

optionExplanations.A: Commas are not the list separator.
optionExplanations.B: These entries include unwanted leading spaces.
optionExplanations.C: Matches the requested four exact strings.

practiceQuiz.scenario: In a successful full Module Merge (not a checkout-blocked partial merge), which target/source outcome is documented?

options.text: The target remains and the source is removed after the full merge.
The Source Module is kept; the Target Module is deleted.
Both Modules are kept and linked together.
Tosca randomly chooses which Module to keep.

practiceQuiz.rationale: Full merge retains the target; a partial merge can retain the source.

optionExplanations.B: Reverses the source and target roles.
optionExplanations.C: Partial merge is a different case.
optionExplanations.D: Selection order and Switch Modules determine roles.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A tester is rescanning a Module and notices a newly added 'Apply coupon' button on the page that is not yet in the Module. What can they do during the rescan?

options.text: Nothing — rescan only refreshes properties of existing Controls.
Select the new uniquely identified control and save the rescan update.
They must create a separate new Module for the button and merge it later.
Delete the Module and start a fresh scan to include the button.

practiceQuiz.hint: Rescan can do more than refresh — it can grow the Module.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Rescan supports adding controls; a separate replacement model is not required for this addition.

optionExplanations.A: Rescan supports more than property refresh.
optionExplanations.B: Adds the intended new control to the current model.
optionExplanations.C: A separate model is not required for this addition.
optionExplanations.D: Deleting the current model is unnecessary.

quickRecap.value: Small identifier adjustments need not recreate the model.
Dropdown suggestions, not a universal validation lock.
Inspect compatible technologies, target order and conflicts.
Full merge removes source; partial can retain it.
